name: Georgia

filing.name: Georgia Secretary of State, Corporations Division

entityTax: Corporate income tax and net worth tax

salesTax.permit: Georgia sales tax number (Georgia Tax Center)

permitFee.note: No fee was found for registering a sales and use tax number through the Georgia Tax Center.

penalty.note: 5% of the tax for each month or fraction the return is late, up to 25%.

workersComp.agency: Georgia State Board of Workers' Compensation

unemployment.note: Greater of 0.05% of the period's total wages or $20 for each month or part of a month a report is late, plus 1.5% monthly interest.

newHire.note: Up to $25 per unreported new hire, rising to $500 where employer and employee conspire (per payroll-vendor summaries; confirm O.C.G.A. 19-11-9.2).

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Board fine of $500 to $5,000 per violation when coverage is intentionally not purchased.

local.title: City or county occupation tax certificate
local.authority: City or county business license office
local.description: Georgia local governments issue business/occupation tax certificates.

industry.contractor: Georgia State Licensing Board for Residential and General Contractors
industry.alcohol: Georgia Department of Revenue, Alcohol and Tobacco Division
industry.childCare: Georgia Department of Early Care and Learning

cannabis.regulator: Georgia Access to Medical Cannabis Commission
cannabis.note: Georgia's program is limited to low-THC oil.
